guest.notes: delivered as a real device in a device farm, not as an emulated guest; firmware and ipsw are owner-supplied and never shipped

constraints: there is no legitimate ios emulation lane: this entry is a physical device, reached like the eclectics native half
apps must come from the owner's purchase history, so availability is whatever apple still serves for that version
no usb-free path: the device must be attached, one at a time
attestation is real here, which is the one advantage over an emulator: this is a genuine device
last ios before the app-tracking prompts changed the permissions surface that old apps expect
